newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity fell in November.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity fell in November.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity fell in November, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity -- which takes January 1993 as 100 -- dropped to 171.1 in November from 175.9 in October and 176.4 in September.
The indicator combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity.

The central bank created the indicator in 1993 because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon since the 1975-90 war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and economic growth.
